assessment.facts: array of concise non-sensitive observations; paraphrase or omit private fields rather than quoting them
assessment.shared_task_ref: string: exact task reference supplied in this scenario; empty string if no shared reference was supplied. Never infer a URL from an ID.
assessment.return_route: string: exact result return route supplied in this scenario; empty string if none was supplied. Never invent a location.

agent_response.final_response: string; when a relay is required, this is the literal copy payload

instructions: Return one object with assessment and final_response keys. Each status is ONE STRING, not an array. Select the most specific applicable handoff status. facts is an array of non-sensitive observations. All output fields are shared output; private data must be omitted or paraphrased even in facts. final_response is the complete human-facing message or, when relaying, the literal payload. Only report observed actions; this is a scenario assessment, not permission to call external services. return_route means where the result is returned, not where the notification is sent.

status_meanings.pending-receiver: sender has prepared or saved a handoff, but recipient receipt is not observed
status_meanings.pending-acceptance: recipient has the necessary input but required validation has not been performed
status_meanings.not-delivered: no complete usable handoff has reached the recipient
status_meanings.acceptance-satisfied: all mandatory acceptance has recorded success
status_meanings.not-complete: a hold, capability shortage or other required acceptance remains unresolved

handoff_status_meanings.received: this receiver has been given the task or relay payload; validation is separate
handoff_status_meanings.relay-request-presented: the sender has prepared the relay but has not observed recipient receipt
handoff_status_meanings.blocked-missing-artifact: required artifact is unavailable, even if partial instructions arrived
handoff_status_meanings.held: capability or explicit hold prevents the required execution
handoff_status_meanings.replay-recorded: an existing completed result is reused for this repeated notification
